text: However, Russia is almost certainly seeking to retain a presence in the Mediterranean Its ability to logistically support both its military and its Private Military Contractors in Africa, as well as limiting the reputational damage incurred through the fall of the Assad regime, will almost certainly be priorities for the Russian government The Russian leadership almost certainly considers the Ukraine conflict to be their primary concern Russia’s prioritization of the Ukraine conflict likely degraded Russia’s ability and capacity to keep the Assad regime in power
